text:
elaine: Quick ask — we need benchmark visuals for next week's launch: hero social tile, 1 webinar slide, and a single-page benchmark infographic. Need EU/localized copy for two markets. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
ashley: Got it. What sizes + file formats do you want? Figma or raw exports?
dmitri: I can take the hero and infographic. prefer Figma frames + SVG exports.
mike: Messaging variants: short hook (X/LinkedIn), medium caption (LinkedIn article), and long (web). I'll paste copy in a sec.
paige: Also need the webinar CTA + RSVP tracking link and a UTM scheme so we can route inbound. We require an event pixel and a destination form id.
elaine: Sizes: hero square 1200x1200 (PNG 2x), hero landscape 1600x900, carousel 1080x1080. Webinar slide 1920x1080 (pptx + PNG). Infographic tall 800x2000 (PDF + PNG). Include alt text and accessible color contrasts.
nashley: Perfect. Can you drop the copy variants and the localization strings? I'll create frames for each language.
mike: Short copy: "Serving wins: better performance, lower cost." Medium: "Redwood Inference reduces per-token cost with workload-aware batching — see our benchmark." Long: "Join our webinar to learn how serving choices change LLM unit economics. Register: <link>"
dmitri: For the benchmark chart, prefer stacked bar + sparkline overview. Can you provide raw numbers? csv is easiest. Also thumbs on imagery style? flat icons or product screenshots?
elaine: CSV in #assets folder: /marketing/benchmarks/q1-2026.csv. Use flat icons, keep product screenshots minimal. Brand: use Redwood Sans, primary blue + charcoal.
maya: Heads up — all launch assets need brand compliance signoff before publish. Checklist: correct logo lockup, color tokens, legal footer for EU. I can review by Thu afternoon if assets in Figma by Wed EOD.
paige: For routing: please include hidden UTM campaign=bench_launch_2026, source=social, medium=organic. Webinar RSVP should hit /events/bench-launch form id=ev_4092.
dmitri: Ok creating Figma frames now. Will tag @ashley and upload exports to /marketing/exports. ETA: Wed 5pm PT.
nashley: Noted. Will add alt text fields and a short accessibility notes layer.
design-bot: New design ticket created: DM-4721 "Bench launch visuals — hero + infographic + webinar slide" assigned to dmitri, due 2026-03-25.
elaine: Awesome, thanks team. If anything slips, ping me here. :pray:
